title: The Little Pink Lace Secrets
subtitle: A New Year's Morning, Six Missing Sets
sourcePriority: User's latest direction wins over prior assistant proposals; change only to resolve material character/chronology constraints.
scope: 2026-01-01: Ankita morning and office through 13:00, simultaneous parcel and committee story. She is still at work at cutoff; return home, postcutoff office beats and wardrobe decisions deferred.

baseline.ankita: 30, confident IT tech lead, maintains fitness through park mobility/yoga and walking; professional and approachable.
baseline.kabir: Ankita's husband, playful affection and a supportive relationship.
baseline.rajeev: Kabir's father; household elder; current Atlas has unreciprocated private attraction as proposal.
baseline.karan: 22, Kabir's younger twin brother, lives in the same family home; outgoing, preparing for MBA/management roles and freelances.
baseline.aman: 22, Karan's twin, lives in same family home; more reserved, preparing for Java/backend job interviews.
baseline.home: Gulmohar Heights, Gurgaon; Ankita, Kabir, Rajeev, Karan, Aman share a home. This residency is newly established in this working draft.
baseline.work: New Year's Day office on-call production-release support; holiday exception, not routine attendance.
baseline.commute: Company carpool cab booked for 08:05; she is not driving herself today.
baseline.fitness: She does 25–30 minutes of brisk walking and group mobility/stretching in the society park before work. No gym membership or personal trainer has been assumed; gym/PT can get an independent later arc.

plotObject.visual: Six pink innerwear sets, one pink personal adult item and instruction leaflet in a private parcel
plotObject.readerSecret: Ankita and Kabir ordered together; do not reveal that reason to readers in EP02.
plotObject.factualClarification: An adult personal item does not mean a person is dissatisfied with their marriage. That belief is a false assumption by the intruding men.
plotObject.distribution: Six sets: Gopal 1, Mahendra 1, Om 1, Subhash 1, Mohan 1, Arvind 1. Rajeev receives the remaining parcel, personal item, paperwork and damaged packaging (zero sets remain).
plotObject.propertyNote: Each removal is unauthorized and independently concealed. None of the six has evidence of another's removal, though elders may know contents were exposed.
plotObject.consent: Opening, retaining items or exploiting private information are violations; they should not be framed as consensual seduction or evidence of Ankita's wishes.

timeline.title: The First Greeting
timeline.action: Ankita wakes on New Year's morning. Kabir greets her and playfully jokes about the holiday work call. Affectionate hand-holding and brief hug; she reciprocates.
dialogue: Happy New Year. Holiday mein bhi release? Tumhare servers ko kab chhutti milegi?
Jab tum mere liye breakfast banaoge bina kisi reminder ke.
timeline.herReaction: Playful, comfortable, affectionate; established marriage remains warm.
timeline.privateThought: Kabir admires how she balances her work and presence at home.
hooks: Marital affection is real; later rumors will be demonstrably false.

timeline.title: The Morning Walk
timeline.action: Ankita goes for a brisk walk wearing a modest fitted athletic jacket, running tights and trainers. Rohan passes on his morning walk; Nikhil is cooling down after a run. They exchange a few friendly New Year's greetings.
dialogue: New Year, same disciplined walking schedule?
At least someone here keeps resolutions past Day One.
That includes me. Ask me again next Monday.
timeline.herReaction: Comfortable neighbourly teasing; she does not read the remarks as invitations.
timeline.privateThought: Rohan notices Ankita's confidence and energy; Nikhil appreciates her consistency. Neither makes an inappropriate proposal.
hooks: Other husbands already have believable reasons to meet her outside social functions.

timeline.title: Posture and Permission
timeline.action: Fitness trainer Vivek runs a light group mobility session. He asks permission before briefly correcting Ankita's forearm alignment, then demonstrates the movement himself. Vikram arrives for a short cooldown and remarks on the group's punctuality.
dialogue: Ankita, shoulder thoda relax karo. Elbow angle dikha doon?
Haan, but I'll adjust it myself after that.
New Year's Day and you all are still on time? Impressive.
timeline.herReaction: She registers the closeness as a training interaction, keeps her control over touch and returns to exercise.
timeline.privateThought: Vivek admires her commitment and appearance but does not express a sexual proposition. Vikram notices she has become a familiar member of the morning group.
hooks: Fitness world gives recurring society encounters with a distinct context; any flirt later requires its own event.

timeline.title: Two Brothers, Two Ways of Noticing
timeline.action: The adult twins live here and are eating breakfast. Karan openly compliments Ankita's energy and how she looks ready before everyone else; Aman quietly asks for an interview preparation referral. Rajeev watches the family interaction without revealing his private interest.
dialogue: Bhabhi, aapka fitness discipline dekhke mere resolutions ko sharam aa rahi hai.
Toh aaj se tum dono mere saath walk pe.
Actually, ek Java interview call aaya hai. Shaam ko resume dekh lengi?
Aman, kal ki tarah raat tak laptop mat chalana.
timeline.herReaction: Amused by Karan, warm toward Aman, comfortable in the shared household.
timeline.privateThought: Karan's attention includes a private attraction he does not express; Aman primarily admires her competence. Ankita treats both as family.
hooks: Both twins are present naturally; Karan's outward banter contrasts with Aman's quieter trust and study needs.

timeline.title: The Cream Kurti and the Last Look
timeline.action: Ankita dresses in a cream embroidered kurti, tailored beige blazer and fitted trousers; long wavy hair, earrings and laptop bag complete the look. Kabir compliments her and gives her an affectionate goodbye. Rajeev sees her passing the corridor and keeps his inappropriate private attraction unspoken.
dialogue: Meeting room mein sab tumhari slides dekhenge ya tumhari confidence?
Meri slides. Aur tum aaj ghar par apni chai dhundhna.
Cab time par aa rahi hai, beta?
timeline.herReaction: She appreciates her husband's appreciation and reads Rajeev's concern as normal family care.
timeline.privateThought: Rajeev's one-sided attraction is private and not shared or reciprocated; he does not act.
hooks: The reader knows Rajeev's hidden viewpoint before the later parcel contact.

timeline.title: Two Faces in the Lift
timeline.action: Society event duo Ayaan and Armaan enter the lift with community-week posters. Their biological relationship is not established as twins. Ayaan openly compliments Ankita's formal styling; Armaan is quieter and notices her composure. She adjusts her blazer and changes the subject to registration.
dialogue: Ankita di, New Year pe bhi office? You look completely ready for a board meeting.
Board meeting nahi, production release. Aur tum log posters late mat karna.
QR code update kar diya hai. Aapko bhej denge.
Great, then humari committee bach jayegi.
timeline.herReaction: Accepts the compliment as light banter and keeps the conversation on the event.
timeline.privateThought: Both men notice her style differently; there is no mutual relationship or physical contact.
hooks: Future society duo contacts can recur without confusing this duo with Karan–Aman.

timeline.title: Sharmi's New Year Tease
timeline.action: Sharmi, the shared society friend for all five women, intercepts Ankita briefly on the way to her cab. She notices Ankita's polished appearance and teases her about dressing up even for a holiday shift. Ankita laughs and promises to answer the committee message later.
dialogue: Ankita, New Year aur tum office-ready? Society ke liye bhi thoda time bachana.
Release green ho jaye, phir tumhari committee ki poori duniya sambhal lungi.
Deal. Aur look very elegant today.
Thank you, madam coordinator. Ab cab miss mat karwana.
timeline.herReaction: Easy woman-to-woman friendship, amused and at ease; no private parcel knowledge.
timeline.privateThought: Sharmi notices her friend's confidence and work demands. She has no reason to suspect what will later happen to the package.
hooks: Common society friend is in the day naturally and can help question strange society behavior in later episodes.

timeline.title: The Package She Hasn't Seen
timeline.action: Ankita asks society watchman Gopal to receive a private delivery if it arrives later in the morning. He has not seen its contents and agrees to log it. She enters a company cab and departs.
dialogue: Gopal ji, meri courier aa sakti hai. Flat number check karke register mein entry kar dena.
Please kisi aur ko mat dena bina bataye.
timeline.herReaction: Complete routine trust at this point.
timeline.privateThought: Gopal notes the delivery instruction, unaware of its contents.
hooks: Her explicit 'don't hand it to anyone' instruction makes subsequent circulation a clear breach.

timeline.title: A Release, a Joke, a Second Look
timeline.action: Ankita joins the holiday deployment. Priya questions test coverage; Nisha checks Java service logs. Vivan uses a playful compliment, while Reyansh mostly watches and works on timings.
dialogue: Regression evidence mil gayi, but API retry case missing hai.
Good catch. Release tabhi karenge jab log clean ho.
New Year pe bhi aapka presentation perfect hai.
Presentation pass nahi, tests pass karao.
Latency chart main revise karta hoon.
timeline.herReaction: Playfully redirects Vivan and focuses on delivery. Mild private curiosity remains, but she makes no personal invitation.
timeline.privateThought: Vivan likes both her confidence and appearance; Reyansh has a brief, unspoken short-term attraction that he does not express.
hooks: Continues the established office attention from EP01 without turning it into a completed romance.

timeline.title: First Broken Seal
timeline.action: Courier arrives while Ankita is at work. Gopal opens the clearly private parcel without permission, discovers its contents, and secretly removes one pink innerwear set. He closes the box badly.
dialogue: Flat C-704. Received by security, sign here.
timeline.privateThought: Gopal draws the unsupported conclusion that the order reveals marital dissatisfaction, and privately speculates about Ankita.
hooks: Unauthorized access; missing first set; concealment; later double-meaning comments.

timeline.title: The Chairman's Discovery
timeline.action: Gopal transfers the partly open parcel to chairman Mahendra under an invented address-check pretext. Mahendra inspects the private contents instead of protecting them and secretly keeps one innerwear set. He is aware this is not his property.
dialogue: Sir, C-704 ka parcel open lag raha hai. Register ka address check kar denge?
Yahin rakh do. Main dekh leta hoon.
timeline.herReaction: Ankita remains at work and knows nothing of the transfer.
timeline.privateThought: Mahendra takes the items as a basis for a false personal assumption; his future intrusive concern is set up.
hooks: Second unauthorized removal; Mahendra controls the temporary custody trail.

timeline.title: The Senior Consultant's Silence
timeline.action: Mr. Bhalla (58) joins as the senior client-side consultant to review the release results. He admires Ankita's appearance and leadership but offers only professional feedback. His private interest stays unrevealed to her; there is no proposition or sexual action.
dialogue: You managed the rollback risk well. Was the fallback tested?
Twice. We can show both logs.
I have the test report here.
Good. Send me the signed version.
timeline.herReaction: Professional, attentive; unaware of any private thoughts.
timeline.privateThought: Bhalla imagines a closer personal acquaintance, not an established relationship; he chooses to say nothing.
hooks: Office older-man lane gets a distinct hidden interest, separate from the parcel.

timeline.title: Om's Private Detour
timeline.action: Om comes to check New Year visitor logs. Mahendra asks him to help identify the address on the damaged parcel. Om sees the private contents, covertly takes one innerwear set while alone for a moment, and returns the parcel to the office counter.
dialogue: Om ji, Tower C ka owner register verify kar dijiyega.
timeline.privateThought: Om's newly emerging one-sided sexual curiosity conflicts with his public role as a respected elder.
hooks: One set missing; Om's private possession is unknown to other elders.

timeline.title: Subhash and the Unasked Question
timeline.action: Subhash arrives for community accounting paperwork. The half-open parcel remains temporarily unattended; he looks inside and keeps a set without asking. He hides this from the others.
dialogue: Mahendra ji, register ka naya page yahan chhod raha hoon.
timeline.privateThought: Subhash privately imagines a personal opportunity with Ankita, based on a wrong interpretation of the parcel; no mutual interest exists.
hooks: Subhash's private action creates future secrecy and possible social pressure.

timeline.title: Mohan Notices the Seal
timeline.action: Mohan checks the community health-camp volunteer boxes at the same table. He sees Ankita's name on the private parcel, opens the loose flap further and secretly removes a set before anyone returns.
dialogue: Health-camp ki list main yahin rakh deta hoon.
timeline.privateThought: Mohan becomes privately preoccupied with an improper assumption about Ankita, though his public manner stays conventional.
hooks: New private attraction seed; another missing set, invisible to others.

timeline.title: The Last Unseen Removal
timeline.action: Arvind visits to deliver a society maintenance notice. With the counter unattended he glimpses private contents and covertly keeps the last remaining innerwear set. He returns the damaged parcel to the logged shelf.
dialogue: Notice chairperson ko de dijiyega. Main chal raha hoon.
timeline.privateThought: Arvind's private attraction is newly created by the incident and remains unreciprocated and hidden.
hooks: Six of six sets now removed; outer box still contains the other personal item and paperwork.

timeline.title: The Coffee Nobody Owed
timeline.action: A milestone test passes. Vivan brings the team coffee, not a private gift; Priya asks Ankita to review a remaining bug. Ankita enjoys the easy group laughter while refusing to assume romantic intent.
dialogue: New Year coffee, meri taraf se.
Only if the service stays healthy after the next run.
If it doesn't, all coffees are cancelled.
timeline.herReaction: Warm, mildly flattered, and openly professional.
timeline.privateThought: The men at the society office are entirely absent from Ankita's thoughts at this time.
hooks: Split-screen contrast: harmless office banter vs private parcel misconduct.

timeline.title: Rajeev Receives the Remainder
timeline.action: Mahendra calls Rajeev to collect Ankita's delayed private delivery. The packaging is visibly damaged and the clothing sets are missing, though the adult personal item and booklet remain inside. Rajeev is curious and unsettled but has no right to interpret the items as evidence about her marriage. He takes the package home for Ankita.
dialogue: Rajeev ji, Ankita ka parcel yahan reh gaya. Aap collect kar lenge?
Haan. Usne security ko kaha tha rakhne. Mere paas bhej dijiye.
Bas, aapse ek personal baat bhi karni thi…
timeline.herReaction: Ankita is at the office and unaware.
timeline.privateThought: Rajeev's previously established one-sided attraction mixes with suspicion; he does not know the joint purchase explanation.
hooks: The parcel is with Rajeev; no clothing sets remain. Marriage speculation becomes a future family conflict.

timeline.title: Six Men, Six Different Secrets
timeline.action: In a committee gathering the five fathers-in-law and chairman discuss an improper rumour about Kabir and Ankita's marriage. The four visiting elders have each kept a separate set and hide that fact from everyone else. Rajeev hears suggestive questions without learning the theft chain. Mahendra avoids acknowledging his own removal.
dialogue: Rajeev ji, Kabir aur Ankita sab theek hain na?
Haan, bilkul. Aap aisa kyun pooch rahe hain?
Nahi nahi, bas aise hi. Community mein sab ek doosre ka khayal rakhte hain.
Personal baaton ko personal rehne dijiye.
timeline.herReaction: Ankita absent and unaware of gossip.
timeline.privateThought: Each man now has a different self-serving interpretation of private information; none has evidence of an unhappy marriage.
hooks: They are all aware something private was exposed, but unaware of each other's secret removals. Rajeev begins suspecting impropriety.

continuity.previousEpisode: EP01 — Five Doors, Eleven Worlds; dates to be anchored separately as 2025-12-31 if continuity requires.
continuity.noSimultaneousPresence: Ankita physically at Cyber City from ~08:50 through 13:00, never present in society parcel handoffs after 08:05. No Ankita homecoming occurs in current EP02.
continuity.actorIndependence: Four elders visit committee office sequentially; each secretly removes a set, unaware that others did likewise.
continuity.tally: 6 clothing sets initially; removals Gopal, Mahendra, Om, Subhash, Mohan, Arvind = 6; Rajeev receives 0 clothing sets plus remaining other contents.
continuity.sharedCast: Sharmi has a brief 07:47 lobby interaction before Ankita's 08:05 departure, connecting the shared society friend without forcing her into parcel knowledge.
continuity.ankitaEndState: At Cyber City office, still awaiting later decisions. No scenes after 13:00 on this page.

Should Shivani's school staff-only sequence wait until 2026-01-02, keeping Jan 1 as a home/society day?
Confirm that Kabir remains at home, not the park/gym, during Ankita's 06:20–06:52 exercise.
Leave Ankita's clothing/dressing styling undecided; preserve the existing portrait only as a provisional reference.
